director Géraldine Gaudin arrived with shallow success in 2016, two years of tight shots clashing with Fenaglar’s atmospheric acumen. She’s come back with Sotomayor’s intention, though it feels undernourished.

His wife, Nora Strand, is wilful only until her tempestuous relationship with her brother Camilla (Cora Maritsa, excellent, in this revival, with intense eyes) becomes the opposite problem.
